alt: A richly detailed squirrel settlement built across a highway median, with platforms, bridges, dwellings, stores, signs, and several squirrels living throughout the connected web.
path: media/image4.jpg "Concept plate: a functioning Squirrel Web, where civic Roles, material Places, route topology, and ordinary life coexist as one colony-scale system."

alt: A squirrel colony in a highway median with elevated nests, platforms, bridges, ropes, cache baskets, civic signs, and multiple routes connecting separate nodes.
path: media/image4.jpg "Concept plate: CONNECT made visible. Homes, caches, watchpoints, and civic spaces remain separate, while routes and redundant anchors form the actual Squirrel settlement."

alt: A game interface showing a large mouse colony in heavy winds, with loose coverings, swaying ladders, hanging stores, named mouse citizens, colony status indicators, and several response choices.
path: media/image5.jpg "Reference mock-up: Heavy Winds in a Mouse colony. The final Home MEET should retain the situated tableau, threatened zones, Role advice, and colony context while reducing the action panel to three sharply differentiated choices."

alt: A dense squirrel colony built across platforms and rope bridges in a highway median, with citizens occupying the connected web.
A party of six mice in a wildflower field with encounter choices to gather seeds, harvest blooms, cut stems, study the patch, mark it, or leave it undisturbed.
A colony event interface showing heavy winds threatening a mouse settlement and several constrained response choices.
A horizontal triptych combining concept art of a mouse manor house, rabbit court settlement, and squirrel web in highway medians.
path: media/image6.jpg "Concept plate: Mouse Manor House, Rabbit Cul-de-Sac, and Squirrel Web shown as three civilizational interpretations of the same roadside habitat."

alt: Square concept art showing a detailed mouse manor house beside a highway culvert, with labeled rooms, citizens, water, reeds, and a cutaway view of connected interiors.
path: media/image7.jpeg "Rushbottom: Pipe End, Culvert Garden, Mouse Manor House. The concept art uses a permanent cutaway to reveal the joined room system."

alt: Square concept art of a rabbit settlement in a highway median, with woven homes facing a shared grassy court, a daughter court, citizens, guests, and labeled Places.
path: media/image8.jpeg "New Elderbank: Ashcross, Wooded Median, Rabbit Cul-de-Sac. Inward-facing Places define a shared court and bud a daughter court."

alt: Square concept art of a squirrel colony spanning a creek in a highway median, with tree nests, hollow, lookout, cache, bridge, repair perch, nursery, and many connected rope routes.
path: media/image9.jpeg "Morningside: Elmwater, Creek Split, Squirrel Web. Distributed nodes become a settlement through bridges, branches, loops, and alternate routes."
